source.description:
Lee Shu-chuan’s Return to Vote

Lee Shu-chuan, famed in the 1980s for songs like “Every Time I Want to Call Your Name,” shared a studio portrait announcing his return to Taiwan on July 26 to participate in the recall election. In a heartfelt Facebook post, he described Taiwan as the culmination of countless years of effort and urged everyone to cherish and defend the island’s future.

Fans responded with gratitude and emotion, thanking Lee and his daughter for their dedication to Taiwan. His message underscored the importance of exercising voting rights and maintaining unity despite political tensions, reinforcing his enduring bond with Taiwa

Li Shu‑quan Magazine Feature

A vintage issue of CUTE 俏 magazine opens to a two‑page spread dedicated to Taiwanese singer Li Shu‑quan. The left page presents a full‑page color portrait of Li Shu‑quan smiling softly, with a date stamp “04/06/2020” at the bottom. On the right, a star icon precedes his name “李恕權,” followed by a black‑and‑white photograph of him speaking into a microphone and several paragraphs of Chinese text detailing his musical journey and upcoming projects.
